footer_about: A government-approved manpower agency helping Bangladeshi workers obtain Malaysia work visas.
hero_title: Start Your New Life in Malaysia
hero_subtitle: Government-approved manpower agency helping Bangladeshi workers secure Malaysia work visas quickly and safely.
why_choose_us_desc: We offer a transparent, government-approved process trusted by thousands of workers.
process_intro: Follow our simple 6-step process to obtain your Malaysia work visa. We handle all paperwork and guide you at every stage.
process_step_desc_1: Fill out the online application form with your basic information and upload required documents.
process_step_desc_2: Submit your passport, photographs, and supporting documents to our office or via courier.
process_step_desc_3: Our team verifies all documents and ensures compliance with Malaysian immigration requirements.
process_step_desc_4: Attend the scheduled embassy interview with our preparation guidance and support.
process_step_desc_5: Your visa application is processed by the Malaysian immigration department.
process_step_desc_6: Once approved, we arrange your flight booking and pre-departure orientation.
required_docs_desc: Valid passport, passport-size photos, educational certificates, medical reports, and employment offer letter.
timeline_desc: The complete visa process takes approximately 4-6 weeks from registration to departure.
fees_desc: No hidden charges. Clear fee structure shared upfront with official receipts for all payments.
jobs_intro: Browse current openings across our partner companies in Malaysia.

job_desc_j3: Clean and maintain guest rooms and public areas to hotel standards with attention to detail and guest satisfaction.
